description: Crafters: power flips 'triggered' (an observer watching it pulses a lamp each time); a comparator reads filled and disabled slots (4); a powered crafter without a recipe crafts nothing. Jukeboxes: wire connects to them; a disc put in by /item replace plays (15 to the wire beside it, a comparator reads the disc's value 11); one saved near the end of its song stops. Detector rails: wire connects, a comparator reads 0, a powered one put by /setblock turns off at once (no minecart).
